output_list.criticism: This function mints new tokens and assigns them to the sender. If a large amount of tokens are minted, it could cause the totalSupply to exceed the maximum limit. This would devalue the tokens in the market leading to loss of value and loss of trust in the token. Additionally, the function does not provide any mechanism for the tokens to be burnt or reallocated, which could lead to a situation where the token supply is reduced but the value of the token remains the same.
